{{Quote|Choice is loss; indecision is all loss.|[[Aoloiloa]]|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] an '''ambush''' occurred on the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]] when the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Far Ranger]]'', boarded by [[Jax Pavan]], [[Laranth Tarak]], [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]] transport [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] leader of the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement. They were en route to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where Yimmon would be safe from the attacks that had taken place on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Jax Pavan decided to pilot the ship between the difficult Twins to foil the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] patrols.<ref name="TLJ" />

However, near the Twins stars, the ''Far Ranger'' was ambushed by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] guided by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] boarded the dying ship during the battle; Laranth sacrificed herself against Vader to gain time to the others to escape, but Yimmon was taken and I-Five was nearly destroyed.<ref name="TLJ" />

Vader left with the Cerean, believing the fate of the survivors sealed, but Jax and Den leaved with an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], with I-Five's remains and the [[Miisai]] tree that Laranth once gave to Jax. They were picked up by an escort of the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] and returned to [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].<ref name="TLJ" />
